python3 << 'PYEOF'
import os, re, subprocess

repo = "/bench/repo"
internal = os.path.join(repo, "internal")

# Collect all func/method symbols defined in internal/ (non-test)
decls = {}  # symbol -> path
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(internal):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, repo)
        with open(path) as fh:
            content = fh.read()
        # package-level func
        for m in re.finditer(r'^func\s+([A-Z]\w*)\s*\(', content, re.M):
            sym = m.group(1)
            decls.setdefault(sym, []).append(rel)
        # methods
        for m in re.finditer(r'^func\s+\([^)]+\)\s+([A-Z]\w*)\s*\(', content, re.M):
            sym = m.group(1)
            decls.setdefault(sym, []).append(rel)

# For each unique symbol, grep call sites outside its defining file(s) and outside tests
# Use ripgrep/grep for counts
results = []
for sym, paths in sorted(decls.items()):
    # skip if only in one obscure file - still count
    defining_files = set(paths)
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(
            ['grep', '-r', '-n', '--include=*.go', sym, repo],
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True
        )
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        continue
    callers = set()
    call_count = 0
    for line in out.splitlines():
        filepart = line.split(':', 1)[0]
        if filepart.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        if '/internal/testutil/' in filepart:
            continue
        # skip defining lines (func declarations)
        rest = line.split(':', 2)[-1]
        if re.search(rf'\bfunc\s+(\([^)]+\)\s+)?{re.escape(sym)}\s*\(', rest):
            continue
        if re.search(rf'\btype\s+{re.escape(sym)}\b', rest):
            continue
        # count actual uses
        if sym in rest:
            call_count += len(re.findall(rf'\b{re.escape(sym)}\b', rest))
            callers.add(filepart)
    if call_count > 0:
        results.append((call_count, len(callers), sym, paths[0]))

results.sort(reverse=True)
for call_count, ncallers, sym, path in results[:40]:
    print(f"{call_count}\t{ncallers}\t{sym}\t{path}")
PYEOF
